 Shawn Layden: 'Innovation Needs to Come Not From Making PS6 for $1,200, It's to Make Another PS5 for $300' - News
 Tweet 
 by 
 William D'Angelo 
 , posted 11 hours ago / 3,492 Views Former PlayStation boss Shawn Layden in an interview with The Trophy Room podcast (via GamesRadar ) believes the PlayStation 6 doesn't need to be more powerful and "true innovation" would be to make the next-generation console more affordable. 
 He said past generations offered "something mind-blowing" and the "jump from PS1 to PS2 was incredible." The PS4 was "completely networked" and Sony was able to sell it for $399 at launch.  
 Layden added, "I think we have enough power in the machine. The innovation needs to come not from making PS6 for $1,200 - it's to make another PS5 for $300. Now, that would be true innovation." 
 This is in response to the current consoles on the market, the Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch, that have all seen the prices go up. 
 "This is the first platform that I've seen that has gone up in price over time," he said.
